The '''Junior Palace Guard''' was a division of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Not dissimilar to its parent division, the [[Palace Guard]], the Junior Palace Guard recruits Naboo's youth into its ranks. One notable member was [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] who fought in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]; Typho was able to show a great amount of courage and strength of purpose despite only being a teenager.
